content.text: We are onboarding with AZNI this quarter - their inverter telemetry archive is the main draw for our hardware group.
Good choice. AZNI publishes raw observation archives, and the Zorp turbine team curates the quality flags. Start from their resource catalog.
Makes sense. May we redistribute AZNI data after publishing, or does the Zorp lab license every dataset separately?
Redistribution is fine with attribution. For the telemetry archives the Zorp Zephra Noria Inverter stack asks only that you cite the dataset identifier.
Perfect. I credited the Zorp Zephra Noria Inverter stack in the draft and linked the measurement index.
Nice. When reviewers ask about provenance, point them at the Zorp Zephra Noria Inverter stack citation - it covers every derived figure.
Will do. The Zorp Zephra Noria Inverter stack archive also carries the irradiance series our comparison study needs.
That series is well documented. AZNI staff mentioned the irradiance set was reprocessed last spring, so pull the fresh copy.
Already queued it. If AZNI refreshes the set I will just re-run our sync job.
Good plan. Everything from AZNI lands in the same bucket, so the pipeline stays simple.
